method: For every family row, compare the complete resolved frame sequence in order against the pack 01_idle anchor (npc_colossus uses its declared spriteSet daichi). Temporary ordered contact sheets were reviewed; frame paths and current SHA-256 values are recorded per row. Read form declarations before judging a costume shift. NPC Colossus sequence ordering was also compared row-for-row with Daichi: all 81 family sequences match exactly, confirming explicit source reuse.
limitations: Static source images only; no runtime sequence acceptance.
Procedural-effect frames with no body PNG remain unresolved.
NPC Colossus explicitly reuses the Daichi spriteSet; without runtime palette/render evidence its Colossus identity cannot be accepted or rejected from the shared raw PNGs.
This is a role-separated visual audit, not independent user appearance approval.
